note: Separate source/profile targets: original v0.2.21 NEON, runtime-candidate portable NEON fallback, and prefetch64-only baseline patch. Native full-size parity and forced unsupported-SHA3 rejection pass; screen is not long confirmation.
rate_definition: sum(completed hashes) / sum(actual elapsed including fence)
order_limitation: Early controller rotated variants using position in the reversed outer configuration loop. Per-configuration baseline/candidate order therefore did not always reverse. Retain measurements with this limitation; new confirmation uses stable configuration indices and verifies actual completed order. Native Windows four-pair confirmation and interhash direct reversal are unaffected.
